hypotheses.title: Depth-labeled magnetic Euler source solutions and shallow lineament-aligned clusters
layers: TMI-derived east/north and positive-down Fourier vertical derivatives
Euler SI=0 solutions and SI=1/2 sensitivity clusters
TMI horizontal-gradient ridge used only for alignment, never for source location
hypotheses.signature: Four-unknown Euler source position/depth/offset solutions in 10x10 windows; depth-coherent SI=0 clusters aligned within 200 m of a candidate magnetic lineament.
hypotheses.why_missing_faults: A buried susceptibility boundary or fault-related alteration may leave a magnetic source edge where no Quaternary surface trace is mapped.
hypotheses.confounders: Lithologic/intrusive contacts, remanent magnetization, survey seams, interpolation, source interference, SI errors, finite/dipping faults, and derivative-unit uncertainty.
hypotheses.differs_from_repo: H28-1 added multiscale magnetic/gravity edge covariates; no existing in-repo experiment solves and clusters depth-labeled Euler source coordinates. Gradient ridges only test alignment.
hypotheses.cost: Medium-high; local FFT tiles, hundreds of thousands of moving windows, SI sensitivity, clustering, feature build and paired OOF screen; CPU-only.
hypotheses.data_gate: Current input bytes are hash-pinned owner mirrors, not organizer-authenticated. Four-patch input audit showed tmi_vg scale ratios 1.38-1.90 and no unit metadata; all solver gradients are derived from band 14 tmi. Official USGS page verifies survey specs, not local byte identity.
hypotheses.validation: Protocol revision 2 is committed at 524bf27 and the runner requires exact equality with the committed protocol blob. Earlier artifact-cited commits d700cfe/9eef66b are absent from this checkout; the initial label-free build chronology is not established. The current label-free build passes all three pre-fit sufficiency gates (80.265% vertical coverage, 118,089 accepted SI-0 solutions, 6,309 retained clusters); physical field units remain unauthenticated and source depths are not geological validation. The paired control is fixed as H28-1/T-v2/H27-4 with four spatial folds and 600 m buffers. Screen seeds 160–169 and confirmation-only seeds 170–179 are preregistered. Current stage outcomes and local seed-use status are rendered from the corresponding evidence JSON; catalogue hide-and-recover results are proxy evidence only and do not authorize a weekly slot or establish competition performance.

hypotheses.title: Dilatational-strain and conductivity intersection corridors
hypotheses.signature: Short, co-located dilation/strain-gradient and conductivity corridors rather than independent high-value pixel thresholds.
hypotheses.why_missing_faults: Buried active/fluid-bearing strands may be weak in surface relief but express strain concentration and conductive alteration.
hypotheses.confounders: Basin conductivity, clay caps, broad regional strain, source-depth mismatch, and non-fault contacts.
hypotheses.differs_from_repo: Existing models use these channels as scalar values; their joint spatial intersection as a fault-candidate corridor is not tested and differs from thermal-distance arms and graph links.
hypotheses.cost: Low-medium; local raster transform and paired holdout.
hypotheses.data_gate: Bands present in the pinned owner-mirror raster; source units, processing, official byte identity, coverage and licence require primary-metadata review.
hypotheses.validation: No run registered; freeze exact corridor transform and same-run H28-1 control before a fresh seed test.

hypotheses.title: Anisotropic seismicity-fabric lineaments
hypotheses.signature: Directional persistence and orientation of earthquake-density ridges across fixed scales, optionally compared with local shear-rate orientation.
hypotheses.why_missing_faults: A linear event fabric may reveal a blind active strand with little surface scarp expression.
hypotheses.confounders: Aseismic faults, catalog-completeness gradients, unrelated swarms, smoothing artifacts and sparse events.
hypotheses.differs_from_repo: Scalar density channels are present, but directional seismicity fabric has not been tested; it is not the refuted oriented LiDAR/geophysics line-integral arm.
hypotheses.cost: Low-medium; current raster only after source processing is verified.
hypotheses.data_gate: Owner-mirror channels are present. Official event catalogue, smoothing radius, time window, schema and licence still need verification.
hypotheses.validation: No run registered; review metadata, then preregister a fresh spatial test against the same-run current best.

hypotheses.title: Quality-filtered hydrothermal chemistry gradients
layers: GDR/INGENIOUS well and spring measurement values
Optional 2 m probes only after separate raw-data verification
hypotheses.signature: De-duplicated, quality-screened thermal/geothermometer contrasts and short fault-aligned gradients rather than isotropic point buffers.
hypotheses.why_missing_faults: Fault permeability can focus thermal upflow and chemical contrasts where the surface fault trace is absent.
hypotheses.confounders: Duplicate stations, questionable geothermometers, groundwater displacement, sparse sampling and non-fault heat sources.
hypotheses.differs_from_repo: H27-12 tested simple point-distance features and found near-null benefit; the raw measurement-gradient transform is distinct but has not been tested.
hypotheses.cost: Medium-high; data QA, de-duplication and fold-safe spatial encoding.
hypotheses.data_gate: GDR #1391 is listed officially; the well/spring CSV and raw binary are not present in this checkout. Listing does not establish downloadability, schema, coverage or licence.
hypotheses.validation: Obtain/hash/schema-audit actual source bytes, then preregister quality filters and a fresh spatial holdout.
hypotheses.status: UNTRIED; data not yet available in this checkout.

hypotheses.title: New GDR paleo-geothermal, 2 m temperature and Quaternary-volcanics packages
hypotheses.signature: Independent surface alteration, shallow thermal anomalies and young volcanic-unit patterns related to fluid pathways or young structure.
hypotheses.why_missing_faults: A fault-focused fluid pathway or young structure may leave a signal outside the published Quaternary fault trace catalogue.
hypotheses.confounders: Volcanic contacts unrelated to faults, groundwater flow, uneven sample coverage, non-fault heat and spatially biased mapping.
hypotheses.differs_from_repo: H27-12 found simple thermal-distance and radiometric feature arms near-null. These are distinct raw packages/geometry, none tested here.
hypotheses.cost: High; authorized retrieval, byte hashes, schema/licence/coverage review, vector/point rasterization and separate arms.
hypotheses.data_gate: Official GDR listing and sibling-runner pins exist, but actual package bytes are absent locally. No local download or checksum verification is claimed; availability is unknown.
hypotheses.validation: Do not use until official bytes and metadata are verified; then preregister each arm separately on unused seeds.
hypotheses.status: UNTRIED; blocked on verified raw data.
